remarks: Move right in to this convenient townhouse in well maintained, financially sound and privately located complex, close to restaurants, shopping, train, Rt95 and places of worship. Enter the spacious living room, dining room with adjacent kitchen with stainless appliances. Right outside is the private patio! Many updates include newly painted living/dining room, newly carpeted bonus lower level family room w/ adjacent laundry room, and extra storage under the stairs. Full access to attic storage with pull down stairs (most units in complex do not have this). Upper level bedrooms are light and bright with new flooring, and new barnyard closet doors. All new interior doors. Hybrid water heater (saves electric and cools off the basement! Only two years old. Low common charge ($420/month-$450 with special assessment for siding), which covers water, trash, recycling, grounds maintenance, pool, sewers, community insurance. The only utility you pay is electric (and phone/cable if you need it)! Dog/pet friendly community. Allowed to park 2 cars , not assigned and plenty of spots! Enjoy the sidewalks and picturesque surroundings! Pool and great playground for residents!
